You can also personalize your watch with a custom dial design or case-back engraving. Your watch, your style, your choice. The KRONOSTI STRATA GMT is an automatic titanium GMT watch designed for modern travelers and watch enthusiasts. Featuring a distinctive natural stone dial, luminous details, and practical GMT functionality, it combines unique natural stone patterns with a lightweight titanium case. It features a sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating and 300m water resistance when fitted with the solid case back. watches.name: 41mm Hand-Wound Mechanical Watch | Natural White MOP Dial | No-Text “Celestial Script” Minimalist Design
watches.description: This 41mm hand-wound mechanical watch showcases the natural beauty of a white mother-of-pearl dial, each piece uniquely shimmering with its own organic texture. The small seconds at 6 o’clock adds a dynamic touch, creating a minimalist yet visually engaging layout. Crafted with a 316L stainless steel case and an upgraded screw-down caseback, the watch offers enhanced durability and refined engineering. The black full-grain leather strap ensures all-day comfort, while the sapphire crystal strikes the perfect balance between clarity and scratch resistance. Each timepiece undergoes a strict 24-hour performance test to guarantee accuracy and reliability. More than just a watch — it’s a piece of mechanical artistry on your wrist. Item Specification Case 316L Stainless Steel Caseback New Screw-Down Caseback Strap Black Full-Grain Cow Leather Crystal Sapphire Crystal Dial Natural White Mother-of-Pearl Function Small Seconds at 6 o’clock Movement Manual Mechanical Testing 24-Hour Timing Test

watches.name: Swiss Luxury Watch: 18K Gold Case, Mother-of-Pearl Sub-Dial & Rotating Globe, Precision Automatic Movement with Dual Rotors
watches.description: The watch features a Swiss-made Flywheel movement with a 42mm 18K gold case and a black leather strap. Its 12mm-thick case houses an 18K gold automatic mechanical movement with blue screws and a dual-rotor, bi-directional winding system for precise timekeeping. The dial includes a mother-of-pearl sub-dial at 12 o'clock for hours and minutes, and a 3D rotating globe at 6 o'clock.
